notes.title: Update July 12, 2024
notes.notes:
1. Fixed a bug with incorrect display of weapons in the inventory after loading a save.
2. Fixed a bug where when a player ran out of health in a battle, it was possible to continue the fight.

notes.title: The long-awaited Release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We are glad to inform you that the game [b]"Peter's Journey" has been released on Steam![/b]

The event that has been waiting for so long has taken place. Now everyone can go on a journey with Peter to find a dream.

Pack a backpack, take a journal for notes and go ahead – look for drawings!

Play, share your impressions, write questions and comments. See you on Steam!

[i]The Dreamer Studio team[/i]
